title: Markup mode: a tap sometimes places a caret instead of highlighting
acceptance: In markup mode a plain tap always fires the sentence-tap handler and never places a text-selection caret
Outside markup mode, selection and link taps behave exactly as they do today
testMarkingUpASentence passes reliably across repeated runs, not intermittently
notes: Found by T-0005 while repairing the UI suite, and it is a real user-facing defect rather than a test problem: roughly half of markup-mode taps place a caret instead of highlighting the sentence. Root cause named by that agent: SelectableTextView.makeUIView sets tap.cancelsTouchesInView = false, so UITextView's own tap recognizer races the custom one and sometimes wins. The agent left the test failing rather than weakening it — correctly, since the test is reporting a genuine bug. Note the fix must not break ordinary selection or link tapping, which is why cancelsTouchesInView was false in the first place; the likely answer is a gesture dependency or gating on markupTool rather than flipping the flag outright.
